question:
Choose the one word substitute for the below sentence.

Sara asked her geography teacher, a person who travels to distant lands called?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Voyager**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Voyager"** refers to a person who travels to distant or unknown places, especially across seas or space. (यात्री)
 
 
• **Example:** The voyager set sail across the Atlantic in search of new lands.
 
 
• **Voyager** is the most appropriate word to describe someone who travels to distant lands with the intent of exploration or discovery. (यात्री)
 
 
• **Example:** Ancient voyagers played a crucial role in mapping the world.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Voyager**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Explorer** (अन्वेषक): A person who travels to discover new places or investigate unknown areas.
 
 
• **Example:** The explorer ventured deep into the Amazon rainforest to study its biodiversity.
 
 
 
• **Wanderer** (भटकने वाला): A person who moves about aimlessly or without a fixed destination.
 
 
• **Example:** The wanderer roamed the streets, searching for inspiration for his next painting.
 
 
 
• **Adventurer** (साहसिक यात्री): A person who seeks excitement and takes risks, often in daring journeys or activities.
 
 
• **Example:** The adventurer climbed the highest peaks and crossed treacherous rivers during his expedition.
